profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Extensive experience with computers, development, support, analysis, and interaction with users provides for a well-rounded background for any support or development position.  Unique background allows for quick grasping of issues and perception of potential solutions in a wide variety of business environments.  Experience in consulting and sales provides for a sensitive approach to the needs of users, while corporate experience has demonstrated the knowledge of the need for efficient project management, design, documentation, training, and timetables.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer with extensive background in use and management of big data / relational databases.  Experience with various technologies like Java, J2EE, JSP, JavaScript, HTML, Struts, Stuts 2, Spring, Apache, Tomcat, Weblogic, Websphere, JSON, AJAX, JUnit, JQuery, XML, SOA, Oracle, SqlServer, MySql, DB2, PL/SQL/Stored Procedures, Windows, Unix.

positions.title: Database Administration
positions.description: As Database Administrator my primary responsibilities include the direct administration of the data platforms and architectures with their associated operating systems. Design, development and implementation of database architecture, ongoing monitoring of system performance and capacity analysis, connectivity capabilities are fully operational and well integrated into the information technology environment, upgrade and long range life cycle planning for related hardware and software components. Integrates server/distributed platforms solutions into the integrated technology environment and assures proper operation and maintenance of application platforms. Provide technical leadership and support for computing platforms and platform integration. Determine strategy for connecting devices to platform on which applications software runs. Conducts analyzes and presents performance and/or sizing analysis to assure platform reliability for current and/or future use.. Maintains a broad working knowledge of full range of the IS server/distributed platforms.

positions.title: Database Administration
positions.description: Managed production, test, and development environments for various external clients and internal company operations.  In charge of various tasks, including: Data modeling, reports development, stored procedures, RMAN, Lunix, conversions, backup, recovery, multiple operating systems, Oracle Application Server, Java code management, tuning, mentoring, etc.  Wrote various stored procedures and code to facilitate website usage of external client application.  Managed Cold, Hot backups, and facilitated RMAN installation and usage.  Installed various applications, monitored schema’s, managed data designs, and wrote shell scripts when required.  Wrote exports and imports as needed.  Monitored and configured security.  Edited and authored various stored procedures.   Assisted developers when required to connect and write sql code.  Tuned code where required. Implemented full conversion data transformation from multiple databases Sql Server to Oracle.

positions.title: Senior Level DBA
positions.description: Senior Level DBA/ Code Modification.  Monitoring and maintaining various databases on various operating system platforms.  Conversion from multiple databases Sybase/Sql Server to Oracle.  System administration for various Unix and Microsoft operating systems.  Wrote various stored procedures and code to facilitate nationwide insurance database data integrity.  Managed Cold, Hot backups, and facilitated replicated parallel server.  Installed various applications, monitored schema’s, managed data designs, and wrote shell scripts when required.  Wrote exports and imports to facilitate linkages to existing Sql Server 7.0, and Sybase system 10 databases.  BCP exports and imports of related external data as required.  Restored various files as required.  Monitored and configured security.  Edited and authored various stored procedures.   Assisted developers when required to connect and write sql code.  Tuned code where required.

positions.title: Senior Lead Database Administration
positions.description: Senior Lead Database Administration with heavy Unix system administration and moderate NT administration experience applied in highly fluid development environment.  Document, plan, design, configure, develop, install, manage, maintain, and support several key environments: Production, Quality Assurance, Testing, and various copies of Development.  Work professionally with various aspects and users of full life cycle process on mission critical project: from client management, end-users, testers, project management, developers, and external vendors.  Plan for current, near term, and future database needs, implement as required.  Assist in the installation, coding, maintenance, development both batch and command, Shell Scripts, SQL code, and stored procedures as required.  Wrote and developed key PL/SQL scripts, packages, procedures and functions.  Manage ORACLE 8.x, UNIX and NT environments as they relate to the operation, maintenance and efficacy of the Oracle databases.  Installation and configuration of Oracle 8i webserver on Sun Solaris 2.6.  Handled implementation and configuration of various production, development, and testing environments.

company.name: City Of Chicago-Parking Red Light Project with IBM

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description: SENIOR LEAD DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR. Database Administrator for key systems for city water department. Created over 30 instances for production, development and testing. Installed various versions of ORACLE 8.x on IBM RISC 6000 platform, configured and maintained same.  Provided support for developers, users, and administration.  Developed planning, maintenance, trouble shooting, general tuning guidelines for new installation.  Performed backups and recoveries of databases. Woked with various users and developers installing various ORACLE packages and PL/SQL PROCEDURES, and TRIGGERS.  Created UNIX shell scripts / SQL Scripts, and UNIX CRON Jobs when required.

company.name: U.S. Water Inc. (City Of Chicago – Water Dept),

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description: Re-configuration and evaluation of Oracle 8i web server on NT4..  Provided planning, maintenance, trouble shooting, and general tuning.  Worked with various team members to facilitate company goal of leading edge Dot-Com company that provides free hard drive space to internet users.  Founding Oracle DBA for fast track company.  Sql Server 7.0 BCP export utility to Oracle database import load utility IMP80.EXE. Overtime assignment May 1999

positions.title: DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR
positions.description: DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR.  Acted as key Database Administrator for several key mission critical projects including managing call center database – REPLICATED SERVER (multi-site). Converted data, managed terabyte installations.  Installed various versions of ORACLE on SUN SOLARIS 2.4/2.5/2.6, Win95, WinNT4sp4, HP (HP UX) configured and maintained same.  Provide on-call support for call center.  Provided planning, maintenance, trouble shooting, and general tuning for over 12 databases.  Performed backups and recoveries of databasesResponsible for various production, development, and testing environments.  Woked with various users and developers installing various ORACLE packages and PL/SQL PROCEDURES, and TRIGGERS.  Wrote various UNIX shell scripts / SQL Scripts, and UNIX CRON Jobs.  Project Management Role for Oracle Parallel Server Implementation.  On-Call DBA.

positions.title: DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR
positions.description: Acted as key Database Administrator for several key mission critical projects including REMEDY, SAT and CLARIFY help desk installations. Configured, installed and performed maintenance on various versions of ORACLE on SUN SOLARIS 2.5.1, 95, NT 4.0, HP.  Provide on-call support for Midwest region, acted as support member for several in-house groups.  Provided planning, maintenance, trouble shooting, and general tuning for over 25 databases.  Performed backups and recoveries of key production databases, including HOT database systems.  Handled implementation and configuration of various production, development, and testing environments.  Wrote key scripts to maintain same.  Created several CRON scripts to perform various key functions.  Created SQL scripts for various users and developers.  Performance tuned where required.

positions.title: CONSULTANT/ DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR.
positions.description: CONSULTANT/ DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR.  Provided professional consulting services, (pre-sales, post-sales, programming, analysis, and full life-cycle information system solutions) to a wide range of clients that involved the analysis, development, and implementation of business state-of-the-art applications.  Reviewed clients databases layouts and installation requirements and provided recommendations to same.   Subcontracted for key clients - wrote system to track and report on new drug supplies from clinical supply request through production, to delivery.  System handled tracking of key medical data and information.  Application was the sole source to determine production priority, for production.  Complex system designed on multi-user WAN and accessed by multiple locations across country.  System designed to transfer data to other corporate SQL databases.  Also installed and maintained key windows drug labeling system.  Acted as Database Analyst member of design team for complex project.  Sybase 6.5 maintenance and configuration.  Sybase BCP utility used to export data to external applications and related files.

positions.title: DATA BASE ADMINISTRATOR
positions.description:
Originally hired as office manager, worked role to incorporate computers and then to Database Administrator. Developed multiple applications on multiple platforms for major chemical importer/producer.  Applications designed to produce various reports on clients and sales.  Managed activities and worked on computer programs.  Acted as Database Administrator for multi-million dollar chemical company.  Handled all aspects of maintaining Oracle 7.3 database.    Developed logic, reports, analysis, inter-company database information sharing.  Also developed key financial reports to determine pricing information on database.  Financial reports included key pricing and accounting information.
55 Hours/week, August 1990 to February 1997.
